system.description: Drains its victim of life force, healing the caster's HP by the same amount as the damage dealt.

Summon an Imp or a Wight to serve you in battle. The summoned creature can act immediately.

 - Imp: An Undead/Flying unit that can cast Firebolts. Frail in constitution, but provides reliable magical damage. 
 - Wight: An Undead infantry unit. Serves as a useful melee fighter. You can choose whether this unit spawns with a slashing, piercing or crushing weapon.
Protected from Arcane and Shadow damage. Vulnerable to Slashing and Holy damage.
